newsitem.title: USA: AccuMed responds to FDA inquiries on TracCell.
newsitem.headline: AccuMed responds to FDA inquiries on TracCell.

text.p: AccuMed International Inc said Wednesday it has responded to a recent Food and Drug Administration letter requesting additional information on the company's TracCell diagnostic test.

AccuMed said its scientists met with FDA officials on March 7 to clarify the FDA questions related to a November 21, 1996 filing seeking marketing approval of the test. The questions were not disclosed.
No additional studies were required to respond completely to the FDA, the company said.
AccuMed's TracCell 2000 fully automated slide mapping system is used for Pap tests by cytotechnologists.

Dr. Norman Pressman, president of AccuMed's Cytopathology Division, said, "We are encouraged by our interactions with the FDA, we anticipate a prompt response and we are confident that the TracCell will become a significant tool to aid cytotechnologists and cytopathologists within the diagnostic laboratory industry."
AccuMed develops laboratory products for cancer screening.
